title: Grupo Argos sells shares in Cementos Argos
summary: Grupo Argos sells shares in Cementos Argos
body_markdown:
**Colombia:** Grupo Argos has sold US$96.3m-worth of ordinary shares in its subsidiary Cementos Argos, the El Colombiano newspaper has reported. The holding company says that its controlling stake of the producer remains ‘unaltered.’ The sale aims to increase the Cementos Argos’ free float, in line with conditions of its entry to the MSCI Standard Index. The proceeds will go towards a share buyback programme, previously announced by Grupo Argos on 12 November 2026.


Cementos Argos first debuted on the MSCI Small Cap Index in August 2024.
